tested_failure_model.scope: Complete loss, rollback, delete-recreate, or equivalent erasure of all semantically authoritative durable state inside one primary repository authority/failure domain.
includes: branches, tags, refs and same-domain retention anchors
remembered old SHA when object retention is not independently guaranteed

bounded_argument.distinct_prior_states: Let S1 and S2 be distinct prior semantic states.
bounded_argument.loss_mapping: Within the stated failure model, total in-domain loss can map both histories to the same post-loss observable state D0 with no surviving binding identifying S1 versus S2.
bounded_argument.consequence: A recovery procedure restricted to D0 cannot determine which prior semantic state existed. Fail-closed behavior can preserve safety by refusing an unsupported recovery claim, but it cannot reconstruct the erased semantic state or restore liveness for that state.
bounded_argument.scope_limit: This is not asserted as a universal impossibility theorem. It applies only to the stated complete single-authority-domain-loss model and the currently observed authorized surfaces.

same_domain_variants_rejected_for_this_f: additional branch, tag or ref in the same failed domain
current-copy, checkpoint or journal in the same failed domain
nonce or monotonic witness in the same failed domain
remembered old SHA without separately guaranteed retention authority
required_condition_for_recovery: At least one policy-authorized durability or witness binding to the exact semantic state must survive outside the failed authority/failure domain.

o_comparison.evidence_scope: Read-only targeted O repository search for independent durability/external witness/checkpoint/journal returned no matching result in this bounded slice. Previously observed O repository-local continuation/checkpoint/journal/idempotency mechanisms remain within the GitHub/O authority domain and therefore do not by themselves establish an independent second durability authority under this failure model.
o_comparison.uncertainty: Absence is scoped to observed O surfaces and this exact bounded comparison; omitted or inaccessible external authorities are not assessed.

novelty_relation.relative_to_prior_gc_boundary_finding: Distinct residual boundary. The prior CURRENT-REACHABLE-ROLE-SEMANTIC-COPY-WITH-FAIL-CLOSED-GC-BOUNDARY-v1 preserves semantics while a current reachable same-domain lineage survives. This finding tests complete loss of that authority domain itself.

continuation: Next invocation, resume from this authority-boundary blocker and inspect the next unresolved Phase-1 gate in role-local state. Only if frozen repository policy explicitly authorizes a genuinely independent zero-cost, zero-finite-quota, zero-Work writable durability surface, compare that exact surface against the semantic-binding requirements; otherwise do not invent one and carry this blocker while selecting the next non-conflicting open gate.
